card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way that swells and shrinks every 14.8 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RW Cas: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 94.6 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 3,200 parsecs away.
